line: Every video app squeezes the picture to fit the audio. We flip it, on purpose.
This script doesn't stretch the voice to fit the video — the cuts move to match the voice's real pauses instead.
The old way stretched every line to fit one set size. A line that ran long still spilled into the next.
One real episode went out with two lines talking at once.
Now the whole picture follows the voice's own pace.
One more real bug: it used to cut off mid-word, because the tool's guess landed early.
Now the actual audio file sets the hard limit. The video can't stop while the voice keeps talking.
This isn't a special tool. Anyone can do this by hand, in any program. Find the real pause in the voice, and make the cut.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
